after.en: Run traecli login first. The official CLI documentation currently requires a TRAE Enterprise flagship subscription; Desktop login and SOLO models are not reused. Set CODEXHOST_TRAE_CLI_COMMAND for a custom executable.
after.zh-CN: 先运行 traecli login。官方 CLI 文档当前要求 TRAE 企业版旗舰套餐；不复用桌面登录或 SOLO 模型。自定义可执行文件使用 CODEXHOST_TRAE_CLI_COMMAND。
